description:
Redwood Inference will run a 6–8 week Vertical ABM pilot focused on regulated workloads, initially targeting 1–2 verticals (financial services and healthcare). The pilot’s goals are to (1) validate repeatable positioning + outbound motions for security- and compliance-driven buyers, (2) create a durable set of vertical assets (landing page, one-pagers, security FAQ/evidence pack, talk track, sequences), and (3) generate qualified pipeline for Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) with clear success criteria (meetings booked, SQLs created, pilots/POCs launched, and conversion to procurement).

Scope includes: building a target account list and persona map (CISO/Security, Platform/ML Engineering, Procurement), aligning messaging around latency/cost reliability plus compliance requirements (audit logs, SSO/SAML, retention/residency, KMS/HSM), launching targeted outreach (email + LinkedIn + partner channels), running discovery/demo/security reviews, and optionally executing 1–2 short technical pilots (benchmark + architecture validation) with solutions engineering. Out of scope: major new product features; only small documentation updates, packaging clarifications, and minor enablement work should be pulled in.

Key stakeholders: Camila Reyes (VP Marketing) and Ben Carter (Growth Marketing) drive campaign execution; Soojin Lee (Product Marketing) owns messaging/positioning; Stephanie Nguyen / Lukas Meyer and AEs (Avery Johnson, Priyom Das, Hannah Schmitt, Diego Fernandez) own account engagement and qualification; Markus Klein / SE team support technical deep dives; Naomi Feldman and Dr. Aisha Rahman provide security/compliance content and customer-facing responses; Vivek Kulkarni (Private Deployments) and Lauren Bishop (Dedicated) provide product alignment; Michael Grant / Sofia Mendes support contracting/procurement; Jasmine Liu / Rachel Kim plan CS handoff for any pilots that progress.

Timeline (example): Weeks 1–2 prep (account selection, messaging, assets, measurement); Weeks 3–6 execution (outreach + meetings + security reviews + pilots); Weeks 7–8 close (pipeline conversion, learnings, playbook, next-iteration plan). Constraints: compliance accuracy (no over-claiming), fast turnaround on security questionnaires, consistent packaging/pricing guidance, and tight feedback loops between Sales/PMM/Security/SE. Deliverables: vertical messaging frameworks, ABM landing page + one-pagers, security FAQ and evidence pack index, outbound sequences, webinar outline, sales enablement deck + battlecard, target account CRM hygiene, and a post-pilot readout with recommendations.
